agent_id.description: Voice agent to use for this campaign

campaign_name.description: Name of the campaign. Must be unique within a workspace.

start_date.description: Campaign start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2025-12-01)

end_date.description: Campaign end date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2025-12-31)

max_retry.description: Maximum number of retry attempts (cannot be greater than 50)

max_delay.description: Delay between retries as a JSON string. Required when max_retry > 1. Keys: d (days), h (hours), m (minutes) with numeric values. Example: {"d":1,"h":2,"m":30}

400.description: Bad Request - validation failed or business rule violated (e.g., max_retry > 50, missing required fields when publishing, duplicate campaign name in workspace)

agent_id.description: Updated voice agent to use for this campaign

campaign_name.description: Updated campaign name (must remain unique within workspace)

start_date.description: Updated start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2025-12-05)

end_date.description: Updated end date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-01-05)

max_retry.description: Updated maximum retry attempts (cannot be greater than 50)

max_delay.description: Delay between retries as a JSON string. Keys: d (days), h (hours), m (minutes) with numeric values. Example: {"d":1,"h":2,"m":30}

conditions.description: Condition groups with AND/OR logic. Each group contains rules joined by AND. Groups are joined by the 'join' field (OR or AND).

join.description: How this group joins with the previous group. Omit or set null for the first group.

rules.description: Conditions within this group (joined by AND).

400.description: Bad Request - validation failed or business rule violated (e.g., max_retry > 50, missing required fields when publishing)

post.description: Force complete a running campaign immediately, halting all pending audience calls.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign to force complete

campaign_status.description: Must be force_completed to mark as Force Completed

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of campaigns with optional filters.

parameters.name: campaign_status
parameters.description: Filter by status. Accepts a single value or a JSON array such as ["draft","inprogress"]. Defaults to all except deleted.

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: Workspace scope override. Accepts a single id (293), a JSON array ([293,294]) or a comma-free JSON string. When omitted the token's own workspace is used. Always restricted to the token's company.

is_legacy.description: 1 when the campaign uses the legacy audience model

campaign_status_name.description: Draft, Inprogress, Hold, Pause, Force Completed, Deleted, or Completed when end_date has passed

campaign_status.description: Numeric status: 0 draft, 1 inprogress, 2 hold, 3 pause, 4 force_completed, 5 deleted

get.description: Per-campaign calls, talk time and cost across the whole company. Campaigns with no calls in the selected window are still returned, at zero.

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: Restrict to one or more workspaces. Accepts a single id, a comma-separated list, or a JSON array. Always restricted to the token's company.

parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: Restrict to one or more campaigns. Accepts a single id, a comma-separated list, or a JSON array.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Date-range shorthand applied to the calls. Defaults to today when neither filter nor fromDate/toDate is supplied.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Custom range start (YYYY-MM-DD). Used only when filter is omitted; must be sent together with toDate.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Custom range end (YYYY-MM-DD). Used only when filter is omitted; must be sent together with fromDate.

campaign_status.description: Numeric status: 0 draft, 1 inprogress, 2 hold, 3 pause, 4 force_completed, 5 deleted

total_cost.description: Cost with the company's currency symbol, e.g. $12.40

totals.description: Grand totals across every matching campaign, not just the current page

get.description: Retrieve full details of a specific campaign including knowledge base items.
Retrieve a paginated list of audience records for a campaign.

parameters.name: is_new
parameters.description: If true, returns simplified audience format

get.description: Download an Excel (.xlsx) template for uploading audience data to a campaign. Columns are dynamically generated based on the agent's metadata input fields.

400.description: Campaign not exist Or Agent is not assigned to campaign

post.description: Update the status of a knowledge base item linked to a campaign. Resets the trained state, requiring re-training.

knowledge_base_id.description: ID of the knowledge base record

status.description: New status value to set. Use 'active' to enable or 'inactive' to disable.

404.description: Knowledge base not found or associated agent not found

get.description: Get aggregated call statistics for a campaign's audience.

coverage.description: Percentage of successful calls out of total attempts (2 decimal places)

post.description: Permanently delete audience records from a campaign. This action is irreversible.

audience.description: Array of audience record IDs to delete. Required when delete_all is not true.

delete_all.description: Set to true to delete all audience for this campaign. Only allowed when campaign is in draft status.

400.description: Campaign not exist or audience array is required

get.description: Export campaign data as an Excel (.xlsx) file with optional filters.

parameters.name: campaign_status
parameters.description: Filter by status. Valid values: draft, inprogress, hold, pause, force_completed. Defaults to all.

get.description: Export campaign audience data as an Excel (.xlsx) file with optional filters. Columns include dynamic fields based on agent metadata.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by audience status. Valid values: fresh, completed, halted, inqueue

get.description: Retrieve the workspaces available to the API token's owner. Use the returned workspace_id values with workspace-scoped endpoints such as /campaign-list and /campaign-consumption.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by workspace status: 1 active (default), 0 inactive

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Token for pagination to retrieve the next page of results

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of voices to return per page

400.description: Bad Request - Provider ID is required

post.description: Onboard a new user/customer into the portal. Creates a complete account setup including registration, company, user, and workspace in a single API call.

email_id.description: Email address of the user to onboard. Also accepts 'email'.

first_name.description: First name of the user. Also accepts 'firstName'.

last_name.description: Last name of the user. Also accepts 'lastName'.

company_name.description: Company name for the new account. Must be unique. Also accepts 'companyName'.

registration_id.description: ID of the registration record created

user_id.description: ID of the newly created user

company_id.description: ID of the newly created company

workspace_id.description: ID of the default workspace created for the user

customer_salt.description: Unique 12-digit customer identifier. Use this to generate API tokens via the /users/gettokenbycustomerid endpoint.

400.description: Bad Request - EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED, WORKFLOW_NAME_ALREADY_REGISTERED, or COMPANY_DOMAIN_ALREADY_REGISTERED

post.description: Generate an API token for an onboarded customer using their customer_salt (Customer ID).

customer_id.description: The 12-digit customer identifier returned from the /users/onboard endpoint. Also accepts 'customerid' or 'customer_salt'.

name.description: A friendly name for the token

expiration_days.description: Number of days until the token expires. If omitted, the token does not expire.

customerid.description: The customer identifier used in the request

expires.description: Unix timestamp when the token expires, or null if no expiration

400.description: Bad Request - CUSTOMER_ID_NOT_FOUND, WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND, or INVALID_EXPIRATION_DAYS

client_number.description: The customer's phone number to dial (the callee). This number is rung first. Country code prefixes are normalized automatically

user_number.description: The calling agent's own phone number. The call is bridged to this number once the customer answers

did_number.description: The DID to display as the caller ID. Must be an active DID owned by your workspace

app_id.description: ID of the app to associate this call with, used for tracking and filtering call history

object_id.description: ID of the record/object this call relates to (tracking metadata)

submitted_id.description: Submission identifier to associate with this call (tracking metadata)

slug.description: Field slug to associate with the dialled number (tracking metadata)

422.description: Validation error - invalid numbers or DID not owned by workspace

parameters.name: app_id
parameters.description: Return only calls triggered with this app_id

parameters.name: call_id
parameters.description: The call identifier returned by the Click-to-Dial trigger API

status.description: Live status payload for the call, present only when success is true

timeline.description: Ordered list of status events for the call, oldest first

status.description: Raw status label for this timeline event, e.g. queued, dialled, Ringing, answered

leg.description: Call leg this event belongs to: 1 for the customer leg, 2 for the agent leg

last_polled_at.description: Timestamp this status was last refreshed from the telephony provider

second_leg_connected.description: Whether the agent leg (leg 2) has connected

call_status.description: Current high-level call status, e.g. user-ended

keep_polling.description: Whether the client should continue polling this call_id for further updates

error.description: Error description, present only when success is false

get.summary: Get Click-to-Call Live Status (Bulk / Date Range)

parameters.name: fromdate
parameters.description: Start of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today. Alias: fromDate

parameters.name: todate
parameters.description: End of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to fromdate. Alias: toDate

status.description: Live status payload for the call, present only when success is true

timeline.description: Ordered list of status events for the call, oldest first

status.description: Raw status label for this timeline event, e.g. queued, dialled, Ringing, answered

leg.description: Call leg this event belongs to: 1 for the customer leg, 2 for the agent leg

last_polled_at.description: Timestamp this status was last refreshed from the telephony provider

second_leg_connected.description: Whether the agent leg (leg 2) has connected

call_status.description: Current high-level call status, e.g. user-ended

keep_polling.description: Whether the client should continue polling this call_id for further updates

error.description: Error description, present only when success is false

post.description: Create a new audience from an uploaded file and/or a JSON contacts array (pass audience_name), or append contacts to an existing audience (pass audience_id). Rows are collected from the uploaded file and/or the contacts array; rows without a usable mobile number are skipped, and every campaign/segment already connected to the audience is synced with the newly added contacts.

audience_name.description: Name of the new audience. Required when audience_id is not provided. Must be unique within the workspace.

audience_id.description: ID of an existing audience to append contacts to. Switches the request into append mode.

description.description: Free-text description. Ignored in append mode.

source.description: 1=CSV/Bulk Upload, 2=Manual. Forced to 1 when a file is uploaded. Ignored in append mode.

input_variables.description: Input-variable registry IDs, or an array of variable key strings directly. Also accepted as variable_id / variable_ids. Ignored in append mode.

tags.description: Free-form tags. Ignored in append mode.

is_global.description: 1 = usable by any agent (default), 0 = agent-specific. Ignored in append mode.

agent_id.description: Agent this audience is scoped to. Implies is_global=0 unless is_global is explicitly set. Ignored in append mode.

contacts.description: Contact rows as an array of objects, e.g. [{"mobile_no":"+12025550123","name":"John Doe"}]. Combines with an uploaded file if both are given.

input_variables.description: JSON-string array of registry IDs or variable keys, or a comma-separated list

audience.description: CSV/Excel file of contact rows. The multipart field name must be 'audience'; its header row supplies the column names.

200.description: Audience created, or contacts appended, successfully

input_variables.description: Only present when a new audience was created

400.description: Audience Name is missing. / Audience name already exists in this workspace / No contacts provided / No valid contacts found / The uploaded file is empty / a required input-variable column is missing from the upload

404.description: Audience not found (append mode, invalid audience_id)

post.description: Rename or describe an existing audience, or soft-delete it by passing status: 2.

audience_id.description: ID of the audience to update

audience_name.description: New name. Must be unique within the workspace. Ignored when status is 2.

status.description: Set to 2 to soft-delete the audience. 0=Inactive, 1=Active, 2=Deleted.

400.description: Audience Id is missing. / Audience name already exists in this workspace

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of audiences in the workspace, including each audience's variables, connected campaigns, and contact counts.
Retrieve a lightweight, unpaginated list of audiences in the workspace (id, name, variable count, contact count) for dropdowns and pickers.
Retrieve a single audience's metadata, including its input variables with data types resolved from the input-variable registry.
Retrieve a paginated list of contacts inside an audience.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Partial mobile number search (LIKE). mobile_no is accepted as a fallback alias.

get.description: Export an audience's contacts, and call history if the audience has been dialed by a campaign, as a binary Excel (.xlsx) file.

post.description: Soft-delete one or more contacts by contact ID, scoped to the caller's company/workspace. No audience_id is required; every affected audience's contact count is resynced.

contact_id.description: Contact ID(s) to delete. Accepts a single ID, an array, a JSON-string array, or a comma-separated string.

contact_ids.description: Alias for contact_id. Either field is accepted.

get.description: Download a blank Excel (.xlsx) template whose columns are derived from an agent's metadata input fields, an existing audience's saved input variables, or explicitly chosen input-variable IDs. mobile_no must be among the resolved columns.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Derive columns from this agent's configured metadata input fields. mobile_no is force-added first if missing. Checked before audience_id and variable_id.

parameters.name: audience_id
parameters.description: Derive columns from an existing audience's saved input variables.

parameters.name: variable_id
parameters.description: Input-variable registry ID(s) to use as columns, in the order given. Pass multiple by repeating the param (variable_id=12&variable_id=15) or as a comma-separated string (variable_id=12,15). Also accepted as variable_ids.

parameters.name: audience_name
parameters.description: Overrides the downloaded file's base name. Defaults to the audience's name (audience_id mode) or audience_template.

400.description: mobile_no is required — please include the mobile_no variable

post.description: Create a Segment — a saved filter over either an audience's contacts (source_type=audience, SOURCE_TYPE=1) or a campaign's dial results (source_type=campaign, SOURCE_TYPE=2). Matching contacts are evaluated immediately and materialized into the segment's contact mapping.

segment_name.description: Name for the segment. Must be unique within the workspace (among non-deleted segments).

source_type.description: What to build the segment from.

audience_id.description: ID of the audience to filter. Required when source_type is 'audience'.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign whose dialed contacts to filter. Required when source_type is 'campaign'.

filter_conditions.description: Filter tree in CONDITIONLIST format: { CONDITIONLIST: { <branch>: { <group>: { <condition>: { CONDITION, OPRATER, VALUE_MATCH } } } } }. Conditions within a group are AND'ed; any matching group in any branch is a match (OR of ANDs). OPRATER supports =, ==, ===, !=, !==, >, >=, <, <=, contains, startsWith, endsWith, like. Alias: conditions. Omitted/empty matches every contact of the source.

tags.description: Tags for the segment. Accepts a real array, a JSON-stringified array, or a comma-separated string.

400.description: Bad Request - Segment Name / Source Type / Audience Id / Campaign Id is required, invalid source type, or segment name already exists in this workspace

404.description: Audience not found or Campaign not found

post.description: Evaluate candidate filter conditions against an audience's active contacts without saving a segment. Returns the match count, percentage, and a sample of matching contacts.

conditions.description: Flat filter conditions. Alias: filter_conditions. Omitted/empty matches every contact of the audience.

match_type.description: all = AND across conditions (default), any = OR across conditions.

sample_limit.description: Max number of sample contacts to return (default 20).

size.description: Number of contacts matching the filter

baselist_size.description: Total active contacts in the audience

400.description: Bad Request - Audience Id is required

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of segments for the caller's workspace, with optional name search and status filter.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: 0 = Inactive, 1 = Active. Deleted segments are always excluded.

get.description: Retrieve a lightweight, unpaginated list of every non-deleted segment in the workspace (id, name, variable count, contact count) for use in dropdowns and pickers.
Retrieve one segment's full configuration, including its parsed filter conditions and parent audience.

400.description: Bad Request - Segment Id is required

post.description: Update a segment's name, description, audience, filters, tags, or status. Passing status=2 soft-deletes the segment.

segment_name.description: New name. Must be unique within the workspace (among non-deleted segments, excluding this one).

audience_id.description: Re-scope the segment to a different audience.

conditions.description: New filter, flat format. Alias: filter_conditions.

400.description: Bad Request - Segment Id is required, or segment name already exists in this workspace

404.description: Segment not found or Audience not found

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of a segment's materialized contacts (the mapping created at segment-build time), with optional mobile number search.

400.description: Bad Request - Segment Id is required

get.description: Export a segment's contacts as an Excel (.xlsx) file. Includes a Call History sheet when the segment has been dialed by a campaign.

400.description: Bad Request - Segment Id is required

get.description: Retrieve a lightweight list of campaigns (id + label) in the caller's workspace, for use in dropdowns and pickers. No pagination.

agent_id.description: Voice agent attached to the campaign, if any

post.description: Connect Audiences and/or Segments to a campaign. Only the links are stored in campaign_audience_sources; no contacts are copied at attach time — connected contacts are materialized in the background.

audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to attach. At least one of audience_ids or segment_ids is required.

segment_ids.description: Segment IDs to attach. At least one of audience_ids or segment_ids is required.

total.description: Total number of source links created/updated

400.description: Campaign not found, no audience_ids/segment_ids passed, an id not found in this workspace, or an attached source is missing agent input fields

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of contacts from every Audience and Segment currently connected to a campaign.

post.description: Create a new User Defined input variable in the workspace's registry. The variable key must be unique across the workspace's own variables and the global System variables.

variable_key.description: Unique key for the variable. Letters, numbers and underscore only, and must start with a letter or underscore.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid variable_key format, invalid type, or variable_key already exists

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of input variables for the workspace (System + User Defined), including where each variable is currently used and whether it can be edited or deleted.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: One or more data types, comma-separated (e.g. string,name)

parameters.name: agent_type
parameters.description: 2=Chat, 3=Voice, 4=General. Hides System variables not applicable to that agent type (currently mobile_no for 2 and 4).

post.description: Update a User Defined input variable's type/description, or soft-delete it by passing status = 2. System variables cannot be modified, and deleting a variable that is still in use by an agent or audience is blocked.

variable_id.description: ID of the input variable to update

variable_key.description: Accepted but ignored - the variable key is immutable and is never changed

200.description: Input variable updated or deleted successfully

400.description: Bad Request - invalid type, or variable is in use by an agent/audience and cannot be deleted
